SHF_radical_plan = {
	name = "SHF_radical_plan"
	desc = "SHF_radical_plan_desc"

	allowed = {
		original_tag = SHF
	}
	enable = {
		NOT = { is_historical_focus_on = yes }
		OR = {
			has_global_flag = mk_great_political_turn
			check_variable = { global.mk_absurd_temp > 39 }
			has_country_flag = SHF_branch_b
		}
	}
	abort = {
		OR = {
			is_historical_focus_on = yes
